messages:
Tom - Growth: quick Q from the all-hands: leadership asked for clarity on partner incentives for this quarter and how that maps to pipeline coverage. can we outline the proposed changes and impact? tagging @Marta @Aisha @Elena.
Marta - Partnerships: short summary: 1) bump partner referral credit to 7% for named accounts, 2) add $5k onboarding credit for co-sell deals > $100k, 3) pilot joint SDR credits in NA. goal = more partner-driven pipeline without eroding ACV.
Aisha - Finance: high level ok but we need modeled scenarios. will run three cases: conservative (5% uptake), base (15%), aggressive (30%). need avg deal size assumptions from Sales Ops.
Elena - Sales Ops: avg deal for partner-sourced named accounts = $120k, ok to use that. for pipeline coverage, we need to mark partner-influenced opps with a new tag "partner-influence" so forecasting includes them. PR with CRM field changes will take 4 days.
Priya - Product: from product side, if partners drive more integrations we should prioritize a lightweight onboarding SDK. can we include a note about investing one eng sprint to make partner demos reproducible? that will reduce enablement time.
Tom - Growth: sounds good. Marta, how do you see incentives affecting close velocity?
Marta - Partnerships: expecting ~10% faster close for referred deals (shorter procurement), and higher acceptance of dedicated enablement slots. joint SDR pilot should increase MQL-to-SQL by ~8% based on prior pilots.
Aisha - Finance: please share expected uplift numbers in a tiny table. I'll plug them into the model. also need expected incremental credits expense vs. lifetime value assumptions.
Elena - Sales Ops: CRM mapping snippet for forecast inclusion:
```
WHEN opp.stage IN ('proposal','negotiation','closed_won') AND opp.partner_id IS NOT NULL
SET opp.tag += 'partner-influence'
```
I'll include this in the PR and add a dashboard tile for partner-sourced pipeline coverage.
Chris (CEO): high-level thumbs up. prioritize the pilot in NA and keep global rollouts gated on clear ROI after 8 weeks. please keep the communications short to AEs so they can sell with the new terms.
Marta - Partnerships: action items: I'll draft the partner incentive one-pager + pilot brief by Tue and share with Aisha/Elena.
Aisha - Finance: action items: I'll produce the three-scenario model and share by Wed COB.
Elena - Sales Ops: action items: CRM PR + dashboard tile, will aim for EOD Thursday.
Priya - Product: action item: scope the onboarding SDK sprint, will follow up in #eng-prod.
Tom - Growth: I'll write the AE FAQ and sample email for partner-sourced leads. will share draft in the next 24h.
all-hands-bot: Notes + slides uploaded: https://redwood.company/all-hands/1748001111-deck. Add comments there for follow-ups.
Tom - Growth: thanks all. can we sync Thursday 9:30am PT for a 20min check on progress?
Marta - Partnerships: I'll be there.
Elena - Sales Ops: yes.
Aisha - Finance: calendar invite accepted.
Chris (CEO): good cadence. close the loop with results after the 8-week pilot. :rocket:
